column1: # Which (preset, ISA) combinations of `make defconfig` have a green preset boot row.
# Read by tools/build/defconfig_menu.py (the menu marks the rest experimental) and checked by its --self-test.
# Columns, tab separated: preset, isa, status (green|experimental), evidence (the row or run that proves green; - for experimental).
# The preset-boot-rows work fills the evidence column; until a row exists a green line names the QEMU run that booted it.
